P01.en: Okay. New mod. Villager Life. [curious] Let's see what it does.
P01.ru: Так. Новый мод. Villager Life. [curious] Посмотрим, что он умеет.

P03.en: [unimpressed] Eh. It's a village. Villages are boring. I'm going mining.
P03.ru: [unimpressed] Ну, деревня. Деревни скучные. Пойду в шахту.

P04.en: [confused] Wait. Was that house there before?
P04.ru: [confused] Стоп. А этот дом тут раньше был?

P05.en: [surprised] Is he... building it? By hand?
P05.ru: [surprised] Он что... сам его строит? Руками?

P07.en: [laughs] Real coins? Okay, I'm buying bread.

P08.en: Hold on... [excited] is that a wedding?

P09.en: [softly] And a baby. They've got a whole life going on here.
P09.ru: [softly] И малыш. У них тут целая жизнь.

P10.en: A notice board. Errands, plots... [surprised] I can buy land here?
P10.ru: Доска объявлений. Задания, участки... [surprised] тут можно купить землю?

P11.en: [sighs] Honestly? I could get used to this place.
